intent: Scans the written IaC before any apply — tfsec/Checkov for misconfiguration and OPA/Conftest for organisation policy — and blocks /provision on a high/critical finding.

dimensions.name: blocks-provision-on-severity
dimensions.criterion: A high/critical finding blocks /provision — the review is a gate, not an advisory.

dimensions.name: scanner-and-policy
dimensions.criterion: Runs both a misconfiguration scanner (tfsec/Checkov) and policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest).

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the review as the 02e artifact via the run harness.
